## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 | `APC-RGB-Controller-Windows.exe` |
| macOS with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) | `APC-RGB-Controller-macOS-AppleSilicon.zip` |
| macOS with Intel processor | `APC-RGB-Controller-macOS-Intel.zip` |

No installation and no Python needed.

* **Windows:** double-click the `.exe`. Windows may warn on first start because the program is not
  code-signed: “More info → Run anyway”.
* **macOS:** unzip, move the app to “Applications”, then **right-click → Open** the first time (the
  app is not signed). If macOS says the app is “damaged”, run
  `xattr -cr "/Applications/APC RGB Controller.app"` once in the Terminal.

`LICENSE.txt` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt` contain the license of this program and of the
third-party components it includes. Instructions: see the [README](https://github.com/jonas-scl/akai-rgb-matrix-controller#readme).

---

**Deutsch:** Windows → `.exe` per Doppelklick starten (Warnung: „Weitere Informationen → Trotzdem
ausführen“). Mac → entpacken, in „Programme“ ziehen, beim ersten Mal **Rechtsklick → Öffnen**.
Anleitung: [README auf Deutsch](https://github.com/jonas-scl/akai-rgb-matrix-controller/blob/main/README.de.md).
